result.finding: PII (Personally Identifiable Information) - The application stores pet owner personal data including full name, address, city, and telephone number in the MySQL database.
evidence: db/mysql/schema.sql: owners table contains first_name, last_name, address, city, telephone (PII fields)
db/hsqldb/schema.sql: same owners table structure with PII fields
Owner.java JPA entity: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone mapped from database
No encryption applied to PII fields at rest
values: PII - Owner personal data: first_name, last_name, address, city, telephone
Internal - Pet data: name, birth_date, type (non-sensitive)
Public - Pet types (lookup data: Cat, Dog, Bird, etc.)
Classification: PII for owner records, Internal/Public for pet data
